commands.about: Viat platform CLI
commands.help:
Viat platform CLI

Usage: viat <COMMAND>

Commands:
  version     Print this CLI's version and the release the signed-in server runs
  auth        
  project     
  resource    
  script      
  authorizer  
  apikey      Manage API keys for an api_key authorizer
  role        
  p-user      
  user        Platform user management — list, invite, plus role/authorizer aliases
  license     应用激活码 — show the activation status or activate this deployment
  endpoint    
  tree        Manage endpoint trees within a project
  workflow    Manage workflows in the current project
  schedule    Manage schedules in the current project
  testcase    Manage saved regression test cases (a target's expected output). Enabled cases run server-side on every `publish apply` and block it on failure (override with `--acknowledge-test-failures`). Distinct from `script test`
  publish     Project-wide publish (plan / apply)
  logs        Read execution logs (query / search / show / tail)
  audit       Read a resource's business-data audit trail (query / export)
  files       A storage resource's managed files (list / get / put / rm)
  push        Push local files to remote
  pull        Pull remote state to local files
  export      Export a project to a single `.viatpkg` bundle file
  import      Import a project from a `.viatpkg` bundle into the current server
  call        Call the project's own API (`/p/<slug><path>`, with the project token), or with `--console` any console path (`/projects/...`) with this session's login, refreshed as needed — so a one-off control-plane call never needs the token copied out of the config file
  db          Schema migrations of the project's database resources (`migrations/<resource>/NNNN_<name>.sql`; docs/db-migrations.md)
  authz       The authorization model's rules as the server holds them
  mcp         Start the stdio MCP server (for Claude Code etc.)
  help        Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version

Clear a user's two-factor authentication and sign them out everywhere. Owner only.

The recovery path for an account that has lost both its authenticator and its recovery codes. Afterwards the account signs in with its password alone (and is sent back to enrolment if VIAT_MFA_REQUIRED covers it).
